android.desc:
Five thousand years of wisdom. One beautifully designed app.

Hinduism is one of the world's oldest and richest traditions. Billions of stories. Centuries of philosophy. Rituals that turn an ordinary morning into something sacred. Bhagavan brings all of it into your daily life.

Not a textbook. Not a religious obligation. A daily companion for the spiritual life you actually want to live.

Start every morning with intention. A fresh shloka, a reflection prompt, a meditation and a challenge, all waiting for you. Build a streak. Make it ritual. Make it yours.

Discover at your pace. Hindu deities and their stories. The Bhagavad Gita. The Ramayana. The Upanishads. Vedic philosophy. Yoga. Ancient ideas that have guided billions of lives, all simplified, beautifully illustrated and brought to life. Two minutes or two hours, there is always more to find.

Your practice. Your pace. Prayers with audio and translation. Japa with virtual mala beads. Yoga philosophy. Pranayama. A festival calendar keeping you close to every auspicious date and full moon.

Ask anything. Ask Bhagavan, our AI rooted in Hindu philosophy, whatever you have always been afraid to ask. Curious about karma? Confused about a ritual? Wondering what the Gita says about grief? Ask. No judgement. No lecture. Just thoughtful, faithful guidance.

Know your stars. Daily horoscope insights grounded in Vedic tradition, personalised to you.

Ancient wisdom. Your life. Right now.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Bhagavan – a calm, approachable app for exploring Hinduism

quotes.text:
Bhagavan is a calm, modern app for exploring Hinduism. It brings together philosophy, stories, scriptures, prayers and daily practices in one simple, accessible place. It’s designed for people who feel Hinduism can be overwhelming or hard to connect to and want a gentler, more modern way to explore it at their own pace.

What’s inside (all free):

• Guided exploration of Hinduism through structured learning paths

• Clear, accessible explanations of scriptures (Vedas, Upanishads, Smritis, Puranas)

• Complete Bhagavad Gita with translations and key takeaways

• Deity profiles with stories, symbolism and context

• Epic stories including the Ramayana and Panchatantra

• Prayers with translations, audio, and japa using a virtual mala

• Festival calendar with key dates, reminders and lunar phases

• Daily practices for reflection and focus

• Daily quizzes, crosswords and challenges

• Philosophy and spirituality concepts (e.g. dharma, karma, moksha)

• Daily horoscope

• 'Ask Bhagavan' for thoughtful, philosophy-rooted guidance

No ads. Just a calm space to learn and explore. Free to use, with all content accessible.

iOS: https://apps.apple.com/app/6741321101
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=bhagavan.id

Let me know what you guys think! Please do share with family and friends
